helas-whip.name: Hela's whip
helas-whip.text: Hela's formidable whip, crafted from darkness.

helas-corset.name: Hela's corset
helas-corset.text: Ribbed, tight, and cruel. Worn into the throne room when she meant to be remembered.

garter-straps.name: Garter straps
garter-straps.text: Black silk and steel buckles. A deceptively delicate frame for a vicious thigh strike.

spiked-choker.name: Spiked choker
spiked-choker.text: A goth style spiked choker. It has an engraving that says: Made in Hell.

drops-of-fire.name: Drops of Fire
drops-of-fire.text: Earrings forged from molten ember. Worn by Hela in her court: the first warning before the verdict.

the-fire-dress.name: The Fire Dress
the-fire-dress.text: Hela's ceremonial dress, woven with threads from the eternal pyre. Clings to its wearer with patient warmth.

hellfire-crown.name: Hellfire Crown
hellfire-crown.text: A crown of living flame. Marks the bearer as one who commands fire, and is commanded by it in turn.

command-of-hell.name: Command of Hell
command-of-hell.text: A scrying orb pulsing with infernal will. Hela's authority made manifest: a crowned ember in glass.

magma-fossil.name: Magma fossil
magma-fossil.text: A petrified fragment of primordial magma. It pulses with a warm glow.

seabed-fossil.name: Seabed fossil
seabed-fossil.text: A fossilised fragment from the deepest trenches of the ocean. It cools the air around it in a frigid whisper.

dragon-rider-helmet.name: Dragon rider helmet
dragon-rider-helmet.text: Worn by dragon riding enthusiasts and pros alike. Superior aerodynamics.

dragon-tooth-amulet.name: Dragon tooth amulet
dragon-tooth-amulet.text: A rustic necklace of the small teeth a dragon sheds as it grows. Imbued with magic.
